classification.difficultyReason: Solve both bounds together, then translate the strict and inclusive endpoints into a number-line segment.

content.prompt: Solve the inequality and represent the solution on a number line. $$-2<2x-4\le5.$$

answer.worked:
Add $4$ to all three expressions, then divide by $2$.

$$\begin{align*}2&<2x\le9\\1&<x\le\frac92\end{align*}$$
